data.heading: About Meridian
data.subheading: Fifteen years of helping ambitious companies grow with clarity and confidence.

data.heading: Founded by operators, built for growing companies
data.description:
Meridian was founded in 2009 by a group of former operations and finance leaders who saw that growing companies needed advice that was senior, practical and affordable.

Today our team of consultants works with businesses across manufacturing, retail, healthcare and services — always with the same promise: clear thinking, honest advice and real results.

data.heading: Questions we hear often
data.description: Can't find what you're looking for? Get in touch and we'll be happy to help.

items.question: What size of company do you work with?
items.answer: Most of our clients have between 20 and 2,000 employees, but we tailor every engagement to the business in front of us.

items.question: How long does a typical project take?
items.answer: Diagnostics take about two weeks. Full projects usually run between six and sixteen weeks, depending on scope.

items.question: Do you help with implementation?
items.answer: Yes. We stay involved after recommendations are agreed and support your team until the changes are working.
